name: heading
title: Heading
description: A title in the ink of the page, with the line over it and the paragraph under it.
use: The title of a page, a section or a panel. The class sets the look and the element sets the level: pick the size by the heading's place on the page and h1 to h6 by its place in the outline.

instead.when: The title belongs to a card
The large words are someone else's

platform.feature: text-wrap: balance on a heading and text-wrap: pretty on a lead

classes.name: heading
classes.description: A title at 1.25rem: strong ink, a light medium weight, balanced lines

classes.name: heading-xs
classes.description: 0.9375rem, for a group of links or a dense panel

classes.name: heading-sm
classes.description: 1.0625rem, for a card or a bar

classes.name: heading-xl
classes.description: 1.625 to 2rem by the width of its container, for a page's title in an application

classes.name: heading-2xl
classes.description: 2 to 2.5rem by the width of its container, for a page's title or a section of a landing page

classes.name: heading-display
classes.description: 2.5 to 4.25rem by the width of its container, for the one title of a landing page

classes.name: eyebrow
classes.description: A small uppercase line over a heading that says what kind of thing follows; a p, not a heading

classes.name: lead
classes.description: The paragraph under a heading, at 1.125rem, wrapped without a last line of one word

classes.name: lead-sm
classes.description: 1rem, for a card or a narrow column
